# 10x

> 10x is a curated marketplace of Claude Code plugins that ship quality, not bloat. It is a hub repository, not a tool: you add it once and install any of its nine plugins. Every plugin ships as skills (Markdown files an agent reads), so all nine also install into other agents through `npx skills add` (the skills CLI keeps the list: https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills#supported-agents); the three tool plugins (sniff, ui-ux-suite, recap-studio) additionally run as a standalone MCP server. Nothing here has telemetry, everything runs locally, and every plugin must pass an explicit eight-point quality bar to be listed. Dependencies are kept to what the job needs: ui-ux-suite ships zero, the six skill plugins use Markdown and, for contextify, standard-library scripts, recap-studio's root package declares none while its workspace packages pull zod, Next and React because it renders pages, and sniff carries 17 (including Playwright and Lighthouse) because it drives a real browser. MIT licensed (each plugin keeps its own license). Versions, licenses and test counts were last verified on 2026-11-17; see QUALITY-BAR.md for the commands that print them.

The marketplace manifest is `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Plugins install from their own GitHub repos via the `github` source, so installation works whether or not a package is published to npm. The quality bar lives in `QUALITY-BAR.md` and is re-verified on a quarterly review.

## The nine plugins

- **sniff** (0.9.0, Apache-2.0): Point it at your running app. It walks your real flows in a real browser and reports real bugs (broken pages and links, console and network errors, broken forms, accessibility) with reproduction steps, severity and a fix. A source scan is also available via `sniff scan`. No API key. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/sniff
- **ui-ux-suite** (0.7.0, MIT): ESLint for design. Reads CSS, JSX, HTML and Tailwind classes and names the file, the line, the measured wrong value and the exact fix. Scores 12 dimensions. The report opens with the score and the three fixes to start with. It audits, it never edits. Zero runtime dependencies. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/ui-ux-suite
- **recap-studio** (0.6.1, MIT): Turns a topic or a coding session into one dark-mode HTML explainer you double-click and read offline in about five minutes. Inlined styles, no JavaScript, no external request. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/recap-studio
- **aws-cost-audit** (0.4.1, MIT): Audits a live AWS account read-only through the AWS CLI: attributes every dollar, finds idle and orphaned resources, checks Savings Plans and RI coverage, and returns a savings plan with confidence levels and gated, reversible actions. Prices are verified live, never hardcoded. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill
- **goalify** (3.1.1, MIT): Give your AI a big job and get proof it is done. Writes the brief (a file the run works from) and the condition (one line you paste into `/goal`) for Claude Code and Codex; `/goalify verify` re-runs the checks into a proof receipt. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/goalify
- **humanizer** (0.8.0, MIT): Detects 55 AI writing patterns and rewrites text in five voice profiles, with an optional 0-100 AI-tell score that opens with the verdict and what to fix first. Pure Markdown, zero dependencies, no network calls. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/humanizer-skill
- **loopify** (1.2.1, MIT): Hand Claude a job that repeats. Come back to a log of what every tick did, not a loop you have to babysit. It writes the brief (a standing file the loop re-reads every tick) and the line you paste into Claude Code's built-in `/loop`, with a tick cap and a stop rule. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/loopify
- **secure-my-app** (0.3.0, MIT): Find what a stranger can take from your app. Then close it and prove it closed. Each finding comes with a command whose output you can read; fixes run only on your approval, then the same command re-runs. 65 controls in seven groups. The report opens with its verdict and at most three things to do first. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/secure-my-app
- **contextify** (0.3.1, MIT): Tell every coding agent how your repo works. Then prove it is still true. A short `AGENTS.md` with editor pointers, optional architecture and workflow docs of at most 120 lines each, and a drift check that runs without a model. Human edits outside managed blocks are kept. Repo: https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify

## Install

- Add the marketplace once: `claude plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/10x`
- Install a plugin: `claude plugin install <name>@10x` (e.g. `claude plugin install sniff@10x`, `ui-ux-suite@10x`, `recap-studio@10x`, `aws-cost-audit@10x`, `goalify@10x`, `humanizer@10x`, `loopify@10x`, `secure-my-app@10x`, `contextify@10x`).
- Outside Claude Code, install any of the nine with the Vercel skills CLI: `npx skills add Aboudjem/<repo>`, optionally with `-a <agent>` (for example `-a cursor`, `-a codex`, `-a github-copilot`, `-a gemini-cli`). The repo names are `sniff`, `ui-ux-suite`, `recap-studio`, `aws-cost-audit-skill`, `goalify`, `humanizer-skill`, `loopify`, `secure-my-app`, `contextify`.
- The three tool plugins are dual-mode and also run as a standalone MCP server (`npx sniff-qa --mcp`, `npx ui-ux-suite --mcp`; recap-studio's server runs from a clone after `pnpm install && pnpm -w build`). Per-editor snippets for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Continue, OpenCode and Zed live in each repo's `docs/editors.md`. `aws-cost-audit`, `goalify`, `humanizer`, `loopify`, `secure-my-app` and `contextify` are Claude Code skills rather than MCP servers.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/README.md): What 10x is, the nine plugins, the one-command install, and the quality bar.
- [QUALITY-BAR.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/QUALITY-BAR.md): The explicit eight-point, 29-item checklist every listed plugin must pass.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to propose a plugin for the marketplace.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for AI agents using this marketplace.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Dated history of marketplace changes.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a problem with the marketplace, and where plugin-specific reports go.
- [docs/SYNC.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/docs/SYNC.md): How the version pins stay in sync with the plugin repos.
- [Marketplace manifest](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): The machine-readable plugin list consumed by `claude plugin marketplace add`.

## Plugin repos

- [sniff](https://github.com/Aboudjem/sniff): Walks your running app in a real browser and finds real bugs, with steps to reproduce.
- [ui-ux-suite](https://github.com/Aboudjem/ui-ux-suite): Design audit across 12 dimensions; every finding names a line, a value and a fix.
- [recap-studio](https://github.com/Aboudjem/recap-studio): Self-contained offline one-page explainers.
- [aws-cost-audit-skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill): Evidence-first, read-only AWS cost audit with prices checked live.
- [goalify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/goalify): Writes the brief and the condition a fresh session runs, verifies, and files in .goal/done/.
- [humanizer-skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/humanizer-skill): Names 55 AI writing patterns, scores text 0-100, and rewrites with burstiness and 5 voice profiles.
- [loopify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/loopify): Writes the brief and the line that keep a recurring job running on `/loop`, logging every tick.
- [secure-my-app](https://github.com/Aboudjem/secure-my-app): Finds what a stranger can take from your app, then re-runs the finding command to prove the fix shut it.
- [contextify](https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify): Short agent instructions, optional supporting documents and deterministic checks at Git checkpoints.
